decisions.reason: Requiring standalone comprehension for viewers unfamiliar with Arden does not change the existing criterion to select substantive lessons, stories, or real points.
The standalone-understandability change does not alter the permitted source collection, topic constraint, or source exclusions.
The stronger standalone-understandability standard does not change the existing 70-to-85-second duration bounds.
Standalone comprehension is independent of the existing requirement to select moments with good hooks.
The narrative-comprehension change does not modify the clean visual style or prohibited visual treatments; message 187 already has a separate same-message scope event for this candidate.
The standalone-understandability rule does not change the assigned batch count or delivery obligation, which already have separate same-message lifecycle events.
Narrative understandability does not change the independently stated background-music volume rule.
The strengthened standalone narrative standard does not alter the requirement for client approval before publication.
Standalone comprehension does not modify the separate rule that B-roll must naturally strengthen the message and not serve as random filler.
The narrative-comprehension change does not affect the existing white-text-only and no-text-effects requirements.
Requiring unfamiliar viewers to understand each clip does not change the brand-compliant font standard.
The standalone-understandability update does not change or resume the deferred monthly approved-clip quota.
